tab.failedTitle: The remote desktop could not be opened.

desktop.ended: The remote desktop session has ended.

certificate.unknownBody: This remote desktop has not been reached from this device before. Compare the fingerprint with the machine before trusting it.
certificate.mismatchBody: The certificate from this remote desktop does not match the one that was trusted. Nothing was sent to that server.
certificate.replaceWarning: Only replace the trusted certificate if you know why it changed — a rebuilt machine is one reason, an interception is another.
